title: 2271. Maximum White Tiles Covered by a Carpet

examples.explanation: Place the carpet starting on tile 10. It covers 9 white tiles, so we return 9. Note that there may be other places where the carpet covers 9 white tiles. It can be shown that the carpet cannot cover more than 9 white tiles.
Place the carpet starting on tile 10. It covers 2 white tiles, so we return 2.
